name: Spare Home
replaces: Real estate agents' percentage commissions and the listing fees of the big property sites, such as Trade Me Property, realestate.co.nz and OneRoof
summary: Spare Home lets an owner sell their home themselves, with every service an agent's commission pays for available separately at a published price. It gives sellers and buyers the tools and never acts as anyone's agent.

areas.name: Accounts, identity and authority to sell
areas.summary: Everyone uses one Spareware login. Sellers prove who they are, online or in person, and that they own and control the home or may sell it, before a listing goes live, and high-risk actions need a recent second sign-in step.

features.name: Sign up and sign in
features.does: Create one Spareware login and choose to sell, buy, or both.

parts.name: Home roles on the shared account
parts.what: Adds Home roles to the kit's roles per app: seller, co-owner, buyer, helper, tenant, lawyer, professional, body corporate manager, licensed agent, auctioneer, mortgagee or lender, moderator and admin.

parts.name: Home sign-up choices
parts.what: Adds the sell, buy or both choice to the kit's passkey-first sign-up and sign-in screens, asking only for what the chosen role needs.

parts.name: Home contact and privacy settings
parts.what: Adds Home's choices, such as who may see your name on a listing and how buyers may reach you, to the kit's profile page.

parts.name: Tenant access by link
parts.what: Lets a tenant read sale notices and answer viewing requests through a private link, with no account needed.

parts.name: Home's minimum age
parts.what: Declares Home's minimum age in the kit: 18 to list, offer or bid, the age at which a person in NZ can make a contract that binds them, while browsing needs no account.

features.name: Verify identity
features.does: Prove who you are once, through a regulated checking provider or in person through your lawyer, before listing a home or making an offer, wherever you live.

parts.name: Identity check for Home actions
parts.what: Uses the kit's identity check link and keeps only the kit's pass or fail result, never the documents.

parts.name: Check level for each action
parts.what: Sets which actions need which check: browsing none, booking a viewing a confirmed phone number, and listing, offering or bidding a full identity check by any route in this feature.

parts.name: Identity checked in person
parts.what: Lets a person with no digital ID or smartphone have their identity checked in person by their lawyer or another trusted checker, recorded as the same pass or fail result as a digital check. Every app needs this path, so it belongs in the kit beside KIT-A2-F1.

parts.name: Identity for people overseas
parts.what: Lets sellers and buyers who live outside NZ prove who they are in the first release, through their NZ lawyer's anti-money-laundering identity check or a provider that covers their country, instead of waiting for KIT-A2-F10, which is marked later. Every app with members overseas needs this, so it belongs in the kit.

features.name: Prove you own the home
features.does: Show you are the registered owner and that you control the home before the listing can go live, while the owner's address of record is told so a real owner can object.

parts.name: Title and owner data terms
parts.what: Finds which LINZ title and owner datasets Spare Home may use, under which licence and at what cost, where the owner's postal address of record may lawfully come from, and the same for other countries' land registers. Done once with Spare Rent's title research (RENT-A1-F3-P3), and in one research piece with HOME-A2-F1-P3, HOME-A4-F1-P1 and HOME-A5-F3-P1.

parts.name: Owner name match
parts.what: Matches the verified name against the owners on the record of title and flags any mismatch, but a name match alone never earns the checked owner badge. It is one ownership check shared with Spare Rent (RENT-A1-F3-P2) and belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Ownership review queue
parts.what: Lets a trained member settle the cases the automatic match cannot, with every decision logged. One review queue shared with Spare Rent that belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Checked owner badge
parts.what: Shows buyers which ownership checks passed, read from the kit's check results store, in wording checked under consumer law, only when the name match, proof of control and the notice to the owner's address of record all pass, and without showing who the owner is. It becomes Home's entry on the kit's verified badge (KIT-A2-F5-P1) once the kit moves that badge to core.

parts.name: Proof of control
parts.what: Confirms the seller controls the home through a match on the rates assessment number or rates notice, confirmation from the seller's lawyer, or a code posted to the property. A posted code counts only when the seller declares no one else lives there, and never for a tenanted home. Shared with Spare Rent; belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Extra checks for higher-risk sales
parts.what: Sends vacant land, absentee or overseas owners and contact details changed recently to the review queue and asks the seller's lawyer to confirm.

parts.name: Owners whose details are withheld
parts.what: Gives owners whose details are withheld from the public register for safety, and sellers with protection orders, a checked path through their lawyer with the address hidden by default (which part of the law applies is unverified).

parts.name: Notice to the owner's address of record
parts.what: Whenever a listing is started, posts a letter with a code to the owner's postal address on the council's rating record, telling them a listing was started and how to stop it, and holds the listing for a set time. Where that address may lawfully come from is settled in HOME-A1-F3-P1 (unverified). Shared with Spare Rent; belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Lawyer confirmation when others live there
parts.what: Requires the seller's lawyer to confirm the seller is the registered owner whenever the home is tenanted, someone other than the seller lives there, or the only proof of control is a code posted to the property, so a tenant or a relative with the same name cannot pass.

features.name: Sell on someone else's behalf
features.does: List a home as a trustee, executor, attorney or company director, with evidence of authority.

parts.name: Kinds of authority to sell
parts.what: Lists each kind of seller who is not the plain owner, such as a trustee, executor, attorney or company director, and the evidence each must give, per country, on one model of who owns a property and who may act for it. Shared with Spare Rent (RENT-A1-F3-P1 and RENT-A1-F4-P1), it belongs in the kit; it does not wait for the kit's organisation model (KIT-A1-F7-P1), which is marked next.

parts.name: Authority evidence upload
parts.what: Collects and checks trust deeds, probate, powers of attorney and company records, then keeps only the reviewed result and deletes the documents, as with identity checks. Shared with Spare Rent; belongs in the kit.

features.name: Sell with co-owners
features.does: Invite every co-owner to approve the listing and each big decision.

parts.name: Co-owner invitations
parts.what: Invites each owner on the title to join the sale and confirms they are who the title says. One invitation flow shared with Spare Rent (RENT-A1-F4-P2) that belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Decisions that need every owner
parts.what: Sets which steps need all owners to agree, such as going live, changing the price and accepting an offer, on one every-owner approval step shared with Spare Rent that belongs in the kit.

features.name: Let someone help
features.does: Give a family member, lawyer or adviser limited access to your sale and take it back at any time.

parts.name: Home helper permissions
parts.what: Adds Home's sets of actions for one sale, such as reading enquiries or uploading documents, as access levels on the kit's sharing and access. Acting in the seller's name waits for the kit's delegated access (KIT-A1-F8-P1), which is marked next.

parts.name: Who did what
parts.what: Shows the seller every action taken on their sale and by whom.

features.name: Close or pass on an account
features.does: Close your account when you are done, or let an executor take over a sale after a death.

parts.name: Closing with a sale under way
parts.what: Stops an account closing while a listing, offer or sale is live, offers a hand-over or export, then uses Home's data deletion.

parts.name: Executor hand-over
parts.what: Moves a live sale to an executor through the kit's after-death account handling, once the authority evidence is checked.

features.name: Confirm high-risk actions
features.does: Confirm with a recent second sign-in step before you record an accepted offer, submit or withdraw an offer, bid, change the price, share documents, add a helper or change your lawyer.

parts.name: High-risk action list
parts.what: Lists the Home commands with legal, money or safety effect: recording an accepted agreement, submitting or withdrawing an offer document, registering as a bidder, placing a bid, sending one update to every interested buyer, giving a licensed agent the buyer register, handing a live sale to another site, withdrawing or relisting, changing the price, marking sold, publishing the sale price, revealing the exact address, sharing documents, approving a viewing at the home, adding a helper, changing a lawyer or their bank details, and changing the proof-of-control details. Placing an auction bid is a people-only action that no agent may take.

parts.name: Fresh sign-in step
parts.what: Asks for a sign-in with the second step within the last few minutes before any listed action, whether a person or an agent starts it.

parts.name: Recent sign-in check
parts.what: A check any app can put on a command: the person must have signed in with their second step within the last few minutes. KIT-A1-F3-P1 says only who must have a second step, and KIT-A1-F11-P1 and KIT-A3-F3-P4 already assume this check, so it belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Second step set-up for sellers and buyers
parts.what: Walks a seller or buyer through setting up a second sign-in step, with an option that needs no smartphone, before their first high-risk action rather than in the middle of it. Every app with high-risk actions needs it, so it belongs in the kit.

features.name: Sell as a lender under a mortgage
features.does: As a bank or other lender, list a home you are selling under a mortgage, with the evidence and notices the law requires.

parts.name: Mortgagee sale rules
parts.what: Sets out the notices a lender must give before selling under a mortgage, its duty to take reasonable care to get the best price reasonably obtainable, and the evidence Spare Home should ask for, with sources.

parts.name: Lender seller path
parts.what: Adds lenders as a kind of seller, checks their evidence through the authority evidence upload and shows buyers plainly that it is a mortgagee sale.

areas.name: Property record and listing
areas.summary: A listing starts from a property record filled in from open data. The seller adds what only they know, sets a price and method of sale, and controls when it goes live.

features.name: Start from your address
features.does: Type your address and get a property record already filled in from open data.

parts.name: Address lookup
parts.what: Finds the property from a typed address using the kit's open address search.

parts.name: Shared property record
parts.what: Holds land, buildings, rooms, title, rates, zoning and past sales for one property from rental to sale, as one record shared with Spare Rent (replacing RENT-A2-F1-P2) and Spare Stay that belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Open property data sources
parts.what: Lists the NZ open datasets for parcels, addresses, land area, building outlines, zoning, aerial imagery and rating values, with licences, costs and update rates. Done once with Spare Rent's parcel research for the shared property record, and in one research piece with HOME-A1-F3-P1, HOME-A4-F1-P1 and HOME-A5-F3-P1.

parts.name: Open data import
parts.what: Fills the record from LINZ and council data, showing the source and date beside every fact.

features.name: Write the listing
features.does: Write a headline, description and key facts, with prompts for what buyers look for.

parts.name: Home listing
parts.what: A kit-market listing with home facts, a method of sale, open homes and a status.

parts.name: Listing editor
parts.what: Walks the seller through each section with a live preview on phone and desktop, saving every change as it goes.

parts.name: Checks on stated facts
parts.what: Warns when stated land area, floor area, bedrooms or zoning differ from the record, so claims stay honest.

features.name: Set price and method of sale
features.does: Choose an asking price, a price range, 'enquiries over' a figure or offers by negotiation, with deadline sales, tenders and auctions added as their tools arrive.

parts.name: Methods of sale
parts.what: Defines each method, such as asking price, price range, enquiries over, negotiation, deadline, tender and auction, and the dates and settings each needs, offering deadline, tender and auction only once their tools in HOME-A10-F5 and HOME-A10-F6 are live.

parts.name: Price display rules
parts.what: Sets how each method may show a price, following each country's rules on price indications.

parts.name: GST status of the sale
parts.what: Records whether GST applies to the price, such as a new build sold by a registered developer, land sold between registered parties at zero rate, or a mixed-use block, and labels the price, for example 'plus GST if any'.

parts.name: Tax on home sales
parts.what: Sets out, with sources and a tax adviser's check, when GST applies to a home's price, including compulsory zero-rating between registered parties, residential land withholding tax for offshore sellers, the land transfer tax statement, and the income tax rules a seller should ask their accountant about, such as the bright-line test. One research piece for every tax question in Spare Home.

parts.name: Hidden search price
parts.what: For a listing with no shown price, such as negotiation, deadline, tender or auction, asks the seller for an expected price that only places the listing in price-filtered searches and is never shown. It is checked against the rating value and recent similar sales, and must be updated when the seller's price changes, so it cannot be set low to draw buyers in.

features.name: Go live, pause and withdraw
features.does: Publish, pause, mark under offer or sold, or withdraw the listing at any time, and confirm now and then that it is still for sale.

parts.name: Listing status steps
parts.what: Moves a listing through draft, coming soon, live, paused, under offer, unconditional, sold, sold elsewhere, expired and withdrawn, each step an operation.

parts.name: Checks before going live
parts.what: Holds a listing back until every gate passes: a checked owner with proof of control or approved authority evidence, the notice to the owner's address of record, every co-owner's agreement, the seller declaration, the required disclosures, the listing checks, any earlier agency agreement declared, a supported tenure, the listing fee paid or, once HOME-A14-F3 exists, set to be paid at settlement, and, for a tenanted home, the written notice sent to tenants.

parts.name: Listing check pipeline
parts.what: Runs every listing check in one pass before going live and after each change, on top of the kit's listing checks: stated facts, listing rules, wording, fake listing signs and the same home listed twice.

parts.name: Stale listing check
parts.what: Asks the seller at set intervals to confirm the home is still for sale and expires the listing if they do not answer.

parts.name: Title notices check
parts.what: Flags caveats, notices of claim under the Property (Relationships) Act and other notices registered on the title, and tells the seller to see their lawyer before going live, since these can stop a sale late.

features.name: Change the listing openly
features.does: Edit details, price and photos, with a change history buyers can see.

parts.name: Public change history
parts.what: Shows buyers price changes, relists and days on market, drawn from the operation log, with personal details kept erasable by the kit's method.

features.name: List the common kinds of property
features.does: List houses, units with a body corporate, cross-leases, leasehold land, rural and lifestyle blocks and bare sections, and get a clear message for kinds not supported yet.

parts.name: Fields for each property type
parts.what: Adds the facts each supported property type and tenure needs, such as levies, lease terms, flats plans, land use, water rights and covenants.

parts.name: Tenure gate
parts.what: Blocks a listing whose tenure is not supported yet, such as Māori freehold land, company-share flats, licence to occupy and stratum in freehold, with a clear message on why and where to get help, and says that retirement-village units are out of scope.

features.name: List new builds
features.does: List a home that is not built yet, or many homes in one development.

parts.name: New build and off-the-plan listings
parts.what: Lists homes not yet built, with plans, finish dates and many units under one development.

features.name: Relist and pass the record on
features.does: Relist later without starting again, or hand the property record to the buyer at settlement.

parts.name: Relist from a past sale
parts.what: Starts a new listing from the last one, keeping the photos, plans and documents the seller chooses that each file's licence allows.

parts.name: Record hand-over to the buyer
parts.what: Passes the plans, documents and appliance details to the new owner when the seller agrees, as one hand-over shared with Spare Rent (replacing RENT-A2-F8-P1) that belongs in the kit.

features.name: Declare any agency agreement
features.does: Say whether the home is or was listed with an agent, and see what that agent could still claim.

parts.name: Earlier agency questions
parts.what: Asks whether the home is or was listed with an agent, when that agency ended and whether it was sole or general, and warns that the agent may claim commission on a buyer they introduced.

parts.name: Agency clause rules
parts.what: Confirms from the Real Estate Authority's standard clauses that an agent may claim commission on a private sale to a buyer they introduced within 6 months of the agency ending, or 12 months for rural.

parts.name: Buyers an agent introduced
parts.what: Lets the seller flag buyers an earlier agent introduced, so the seller and their lawyer check before accepting an offer from one.

features.name: Keep your home's record before selling
features.does: Claim your home and build its record, documents and plans before you decide to sell.

parts.name: Owner's home page
parts.what: Lets a checked owner build the home's record, documents and plans ahead of any sale, ready for a first listing or a relisting.

features.name: List Māori freehold land and unusual tenures
features.does: List Māori freehold land, company-share flats, licence to occupy and stratum in freehold, with the extra steps and disclosures each needs.

parts.name: Selling Māori freehold land
parts.what: Sets out the extra legal steps for Māori land, such as offering to preferred groups first and Māori Land Court steps.

parts.name: Older and unusual tenures
parts.what: Sets out the documents and disclosures for company-share flats, licence to occupy, stratum in freehold and cross-leases whose flats plan no longer matches what was built.

parts.name: Fields and steps for unusual tenures
parts.what: Adds the facts, documents and steps these tenures need, such as company shares, occupation licences and the preferred buyer groups for Māori land, and lifts the tenure gate for each one once it is ready.

areas.name: Photos, floor plans, video and tours
areas.summary: Buyers decide on photos and plans first. Sellers get the same quality buyers expect, with honest labels on anything edited, a record of who owns each file and what it may be used for, and floor plans straight from a Spare Arch model.

features.name: Add and arrange photos
features.does: Upload photos from a phone or camera, put them in order and add captions.

parts.name: Photo upload and ordering
parts.what: Uploads in the background, survives a dropped connection, and lets the seller drag photos into order.

parts.name: Home image sizes
parts.what: Makes the sizes Spare Home pages need through the kit's file uploads and engine-media and keeps the original, with hidden location data removed by the kit's photo metadata stripping.

parts.name: Privacy check on photos
parts.what: Flags faces, family photos, number plates, mail, valuables, alarm panels, key safes and keys so the seller can blur them before going live, a check shared with Spare Rent and Spare Stay that belongs in the kit's media service.

parts.name: Photo tips
parts.what: Shows short tips for light, angles and tidying, and which rooms buyers most want to see.

features.name: Label edited photos honestly
features.does: Mark any edited, staged or AI-changed photo so buyers know what they are looking at.

parts.name: Edit labels
parts.what: Records what was changed in each photo and shows a clear label to buyers.

parts.name: Virtually furnished photos
parts.what: Labels photos furnished by a stager or another tool as virtually furnished and keeps the bare photo one tap away.

parts.name: Content credentials
parts.what: Reads content credentials on uploaded photos before hidden data is stripped, and labels edited or AI-changed images automatically, alongside the seller's own declaration.

features.name: Add a floor plan
features.does: Draw a floor plan in the app, upload one you already have, or bring one in from Spare Arch.

parts.name: Simple plan drawer
parts.what: Lets a seller trace rooms with set sizes, doors and windows with no design skills needed, built once on engine-draw2d and shared with Spare Rent and Spare Stay.

parts.name: Plans from Spare Arch
parts.what: Imports the listing plan Spare Arch exports in an open format and places it on the listing. Spare Arch owns the conversion from a model (ARCH-A11-F7-P3) and Spare Home only imports; the importer is built on engine-draw2d and shared with Spare Rent and Spare Stay.

parts.name: Plan output
parts.what: Draws a plan as an image, a PDF and a plain text room list for screen readers.

parts.name: Room and floor areas
parts.what: Works out room and floor areas from a drawn, imported or uploaded plan, with how they were measured stated beside them.

parts.name: Upload an existing plan
parts.what: Takes a PDF or image of a plan from a draughtsperson, builder or the council property file, records its copyright owner and licence, and lets the seller add room names and sizes.

features.name: Add video
features.does: Upload a walk-through video with captions.

parts.name: Home video settings
parts.what: Converts and streams walk-through videos through engine-media and the kit's storage at cost, keeping the original.

parts.name: Captions
parts.what: Uses the kit's captions to draft captions from the soundtrack for the seller to fix and approve.

features.name: Offer a 3D walk-through
features.does: Let buyers walk through the home in 3D on any device.

parts.name: 3D walk-through viewer
parts.what: Shows a 3D tour in the browser and on phones, with a plain fallback for slow devices.

parts.name: Walk-through from a Spare Arch model
parts.what: Makes a walk-through from an exported Spare Arch model without a camera visit.

parts.name: Capturing tours from photos
parts.what: Finds open methods for building a tour from 360 photos or phone scans, and what they cost to run.

features.name: Add aerial photos
features.does: Add drone or aerial photos taken by a booked professional.

parts.name: Drone rules
parts.what: Sets out aviation and privacy rules for drone photos over homes and neighbours.

features.name: Keep media at cost
features.does: Have photos, plans and video stored and served cheaply, with old sales archived.

parts.name: Media archive rule
parts.what: Moves sold listings' media to cheaper storage through the kit's storage at cost, with the cost shown in the ledger.

features.name: Know who owns your photos and plans
features.does: Record who owns each photo, plan and video and what it may be used for, so nothing is reused without the right to.

parts.name: Media rights research
parts.what: Settles who owns professional photos and plans, what licence the seller gets, and whether media may be reused at relisting, sent to other sites, handed to the buyer, published as open data or reused from an earlier agent's campaign.

parts.name: Licence on each file
parts.what: Records the owner and licence of each photo, plan and video and blocks any use the licence does not allow. Shared with Spare Rent and Spare Stay; belongs in the kit's file service.

features.name: Furnish empty rooms in the app
features.does: Add virtual furniture to photos of empty rooms, always labelled.

parts.name: Virtual furniture tool
parts.what: Lets the seller add furniture to photos of empty rooms, using furniture models the co-op has the right to use, always labelled, with the bare photo one tap away.

features.name: Make a plan from a phone scan
features.does: Scan rooms with your phone and get a floor plan to check and fix.

parts.name: Plans from a phone scan
parts.what: Finds open, accurate methods for turning a phone room scan into a floor plan.

parts.name: Plans from a phone scan
parts.what: Turns a phone room scan into a plan in the plan drawer, using the method chosen in the research, for the seller to check and fix.

areas.name: Pricing and market information
areas.summary: Agents win listings with appraisals. Spare Home gives sellers and buyers the evidence to judge price themselves, says plainly how every figure was worked out, and books a registered valuer when a formal value is needed.

features.name: See comparable sales
features.does: See recent sales of similar homes nearby to help set or judge a price.

parts.name: Where sale prices can come from
parts.what: Finds which sale price data can be legally used and shown, such as council valuation rolls and land records, at what cost and under what terms. Part of one data research piece with HOME-A1-F3-P1, HOME-A2-F1-P3 and HOME-A5-F3-P1.

parts.name: Similar sales finder
parts.what: Picks recent nearby sales by size, type, age and land, and says why each one was picked.

parts.name: Similar sales view
parts.what: Shows the chosen sales on a map and a list, and lets the seller add or remove any of them.

parts.name: Fallback without sale prices
parts.what: Shows rating values and earlier Spare Home sales, and says plainly what is missing, until a lawful and affordable source of sale prices is confirmed.

features.name: Get a price guide
features.does: Get a plain price range with the reasons behind it, not a single number.

parts.name: Explainable price range
parts.what: Works out a likely range from similar sales and the home's facts, keeping every step visible.

parts.name: How the range was worked out
parts.what: Shows the sales, adjustments and confidence behind the range in plain words.

parts.name: Not a valuation
parts.what: Wording that makes clear the guide is not a registered valuation or advice, checked by a lawyer.

features.name: See rating values and past sales
features.does: See the council rating value and the home's past sales on the listing.

parts.name: Rating values import
parts.what: Brings in each council's rating values and dates, where the terms allow, labelled with their source.

parts.name: Past sales of the home
parts.what: Shows past sale dates and prices from records that may be shown, and from earlier Spare Home sales.

features.name: Publish your sale price openly
features.does: Choose to add your final sale price to an open dataset anyone can use.

parts.name: Open sales dataset
parts.what: Publishes agreed sale prices as open data with the seller's and buyer's consent, so price evidence is no longer locked away.

parts.name: Consent to publish
parts.what: Asks both sides at settlement to agree before a price is published, and lets them choose a delay.

features.name: Read the local market
features.does: See how many homes are selling in an area, how fast, and how prices are moving.

parts.name: Area market figures
parts.what: Works out sales counts, days on market and price movement by suburb from data that may be shown.

parts.name: Area market page
parts.what: Shows the figures as simple charts with sources and dates.

features.name: Book a registered valuer
features.does: Book a registered valuer at a published price when a court, the seller or a buyer needs a formal value, knowing that lenders usually use valuers from their own panel.

parts.name: Valuers in the catalogue
parts.what: Adds registered valuers as entries on the one booking flow and files each report in the property's document vault.

features.name: See what selling will cost
features.does: Work out the full cost of selling with Spare Home next to a typical commission.

parts.name: Selling cost calculator
parts.what: Adds the at-cost fee, the chosen services and any commission an earlier agent could still claim, and shows the typical commission for the same price beside it.

parts.name: Typical commission figures
parts.what: Checks current agent commission rates and minimums with sources, so the comparison is fair.

areas.name: Buyer search and the listing page
areas.summary: Buyers must find homes as easily as on the big property sites. Search is fast, works on a map, never sells its ranking, and every listing page carries the facts buyers need about the home and the area.

features.name: Search by map and filters
features.does: Search by drawing on a map, by suburb or school zone, and filter by price, bedrooms, land, type and features.

parts.name: Home search needs
parts.what: Sets what home search needs from the kit's search engine choice, such as drawn areas, school zones and many filters.

parts.name: Home search index
parts.what: Indexes live listings by place, price and features on the kit's search service, using the hidden search price for listings with no shown price, and updates within seconds of a change.

parts.name: Search screens
parts.what: Map and list search that works on phones, with filters that read well to screen readers.

parts.name: Home ranking settings
parts.what: Uses the kit's published ranking rules so results follow the buyer's choice only, never payment, and say how the order was worked out.

features.name: Read a full listing page
features.does: See photos, plans, facts, documents, open homes, price history and how to make an offer on one page.

parts.name: Listing page
parts.what: Shows every part of a listing in a fast, accessible page that prints and shares cleanly.

parts.name: Key facts block
parts.what: Shows the facts a country's rules require up front, with each fact's source.

features.name: Check the area
features.does: See school zones, natural hazards, zoning, transport and nearby services for a home.

parts.name: Area data sources
parts.what: Lists open sources for natural hazards, such as flood, liquefaction and coastal hazards, school zones and transport, with licences. Part of one data research piece with HOME-A1-F3-P1, HOME-A2-F1-P3 and HOME-A4-F1-P1.

parts.name: Area data layers
parts.what: Loads and refreshes each area dataset and links it to properties, showing source and date.

parts.name: Area tab on the listing
parts.what: Shows the layers on a map with plain words on what each one means and does not mean.

parts.name: Aerial photos and boundary lines
parts.what: Adds LINZ's open aerial imagery and property boundary lines to the kit's maps, so buyers can see a section's boundaries on an aerial photo. Spare Rent, Spare Stay and Spare Work need it too, so it belongs in the kit beside KIT-A7-F1.

features.name: Save searches and get alerts
features.does: Save a search and get told when a matching home is listed or a saved home changes.

parts.name: Home saved search fields
parts.what: Adds home filters and changes worth watching, such as price drops, to the kit's saved searches.

parts.name: Listing alerts
parts.what: Sends alerts by push, email or SMS as the buyer chooses, at the pace they choose.

features.name: Shortlist, take notes and compare
features.does: Keep a shortlist with private notes, share it with a partner and compare homes side by side.

parts.name: Shortlist notes and sharing
parts.what: Adds private notes and sharing with chosen people to the kit's favourites, synced across devices.

parts.name: Side-by-side compare
parts.what: Puts chosen homes' facts, costs and area data in one table.

features.name: Check travel times
features.does: See how long it takes to get to work, school or family from a home by car, bus, bike or on foot.

parts.name: Travel times
parts.what: Works out travel times from a home to places the buyer names, using the kit's open routing.

features.name: Work out what you can afford
features.does: Use plain calculators for repayments and the upfront costs of buying, clearly marked as not financial advice.

parts.name: Buyer calculators
parts.what: Repayment, deposit and buying cost calculators that never recommend a lender or product.

parts.name: Not financial advice
parts.what: Wording and limits that keep calculators general, checked against financial advice law.

features.name: Share a listing
features.does: Share a listing by link, message or a printed sheet.

parts.name: Share links
parts.what: Makes clean share links and previews that work in messages and on social networks.

parts.name: Printable listing sheet
parts.what: Makes a one-page PDF of the listing for buyers to print.

features.name: Search sold homes
features.does: Search recent sales and deadline or auction results nearby, where the data may be shown.

parts.name: Sold homes search
parts.what: Adds sold homes and results to search using only prices that may be shown, such as earlier Spare Home sales, the open sales dataset and licensed data.

features.name: Find a home that suits your access needs
features.does: See step-free entry, level access and accessible bathrooms on listings, filter by them, and ask for an accessible viewing.

parts.name: Accessible-home facts
parts.what: Adds facts such as step-free entry, level access, door widths and an accessible bathroom to the property record.

parts.name: Access filters
parts.what: Lets buyers filter search by the accessible-home facts.

parts.name: Accessible viewing requests
parts.what: Lets a buyer ask for a viewing that suits their access needs, such as a quiet time or help at a step.

features.name: See facts for investors
features.does: See the current rent, when the tenancy ends and the Healthy Homes status of a tenanted home.

parts.name: Tenanted home facts
parts.what: Shows the current rent, the tenancy end date and Healthy Homes compliance status, shared within the tenancy and privacy rules.

features.name: Post what you are looking for
features.does: As a buyer, post a private brief of the home you want, which owners who are not yet selling can answer.

parts.name: Buyer briefs
parts.what: Holds buyers' briefs without their contact details, lets checked owners answer through the masked chat, and offers briefs only if HM01 finds they are not agency work.

areas.name: Reach and marketing
areas.summary: Buyers' attention lives on the big property sites, so sellers need reach beyond Spare Home. This area covers feeding other sites, printed and social marketing, and showing sellers how their listing is doing.

features.name: Appear on other property sites
features.does: Send your listing to other property sites that take private listings, paying only what they charge.

parts.name: Which sites take private listings
parts.what: Finds which sites accept private sellers' listings, at what price and on what terms.

parts.name: Shared listing feed service
parts.what: One feed service that sends listings, changes and withdrawals to other sites, with each site's and country's feed format as a plugin. It belongs in the kit, built once for Spare Home, Spare Rent (RENT-A3-F5-P2), Spare Stay (STAY-A21-F4-P1) and Spare Market (MKT-A14-F9-P2).

parts.name: Where my listing appears
parts.what: Shows the seller each site the listing is on, its status there and what it cost.

parts.name: Pass-through site costs
parts.what: Charges the seller exactly what each outside site charges, shown before they choose.

parts.name: Home feed formats
parts.what: Maps Home's listing fields, status steps and media licences to each property site's feed format, as plugins on the shared feed service, sending only media the licence allows.

features.name: Print brochures and flyers
features.does: Make a brochure, flyer or open home handout from the listing in one step.

parts.name: Brochure maker
parts.what: Lays out photos, plans and facts in our own print designs and makes a tagged, accessible print-ready PDF.

parts.name: Printers in the catalogue
parts.what: Adds printers as entries on the one booking flow and sends them the print-ready file.

features.name: Put up a sign
features.does: Order a for-sale signboard with a QR code that opens the listing.

parts.name: QR codes and short links
parts.what: Makes QR codes and short links that open the listing and count scans without tracking people, a tool every app needs that belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Signboard artwork
parts.what: Makes signboard artwork in our own designs, sized for common boards.

parts.name: Council sign rules
parts.what: Checks council rules on the size and placing of property signs.

features.name: Share on social networks
features.does: Post the listing to social networks and Spare Social with ready-made images and text.

parts.name: Social share pack
parts.what: Makes square and tall images and short text for posts, in our own designs.

parts.name: Posting to networks
parts.what: Posts to Spare Social and other networks through their open sharing links or published interfaces.

features.name: See how your listing is doing
features.does: See views, saves, enquiries, viewings and offers over time, and what buyers look at most.

parts.name: Listing figures
parts.what: Counts views, saves and enquiries in totals only through the kit's private usage counts, without tracking individual buyers across sites.

parts.name: Seller dashboard
parts.what: Shows the figures as simple charts, with tips when a listing is getting little interest.

features.name: Sell quietly or tease first
features.does: Share a private link before going public, or sell only to people you invite.

parts.name: Private and coming-soon listings
parts.what: Hides a listing from search and shares it only by link or invitation, with the same checks as a public one.

features.name: Be found through web search
features.does: Have your listing found through web search and opened by anyone without signing in, at an address that keeps working after the sale.

parts.name: Public listing pages
parts.what: Serves every public listing as a fast page that anyone can open without signing in and search engines can index, with clean share previews, leaving out private and coming-soon listings, hidden addresses, the owner's identity and media the licence forbids.

parts.name: Web search basics
parts.what: Page titles, descriptions, structured listing data in an open vocabulary, site maps and tidy addresses for every marketplace's public pages. It belongs in the kit, built once with Spare Market's web search basics (MKT-A13-F5-P2) and used by Spare Rent and Spare Stay too.

parts.name: Addresses that last
parts.what: Keeps each listing's address working for good: after a sale or withdrawal it says so and shows only the facts, photos and price the seller and each file's licence allow, and a relisting reuses the same address.

areas.name: Viewings and open homes
areas.summary: Sellers host their own viewings. Spare Home books them, runs the open home register on a phone, keeps sellers and visitors safe, and gets the tenant's agreement before anyone enters a rented home.

features.name: Set viewing times
features.does: Set open home times and the hours you are free for private viewings.

parts.name: Viewing slots
parts.what: Holds open home slots and private viewing hours on the kit's availability calendars and blocks times already booked.

parts.name: Open home scheduler
parts.what: Lets the seller add, move or cancel open homes and tells everyone booked or interested.

parts.name: Viewing calendar sync
parts.what: Shares viewings to the seller's own calendar through the kit's calendar import and export.

features.name: Book a viewing
features.does: Book a private viewing or register for an open home, and get reminders.

parts.name: Viewing booking
parts.what: Books a slot, asks the seller to approve if they choose, and sends confirmation and reminders.

parts.name: Changes and no-shows
parts.what: Handles cancelling, moving and no-shows, and frees the slot for others.

parts.name: Bots and bulk bookings
parts.what: Applies the kit's member-voted rules for automated booking to viewing slots and enquiries, so scripts and agents cannot grab scarce viewings or send bulk enquiries.

features.name: Run an open home
features.does: Check visitors in on a phone at the door, even with no signal, and see who came.

parts.name: Visitor register
parts.what: Records who came and when, from a check-in code or the seller's phone, as one register shared with Spare Rent's open homes that belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Door check-in screen
parts.what: A simple phone screen for checking visitors in, kept working offline by Home's one offline store (HOME-A17-F4-P1).

parts.name: Register privacy notice
parts.what: Tells visitors what is collected, why, and when it is deleted, as privacy law requires.

parts.name: Check-in codes that cannot be swapped
parts.what: Shows a check-in code on the seller's own screen that changes for each open home, never a printed sticker, so a swapped code cannot send visitors to a fake page.

features.name: Stay safe at viewings
features.does: Choose to admit only checked buyers, share your viewing plans with a friend, and call for help fast.

parts.name: Checked buyers only
parts.what: Lets a seller accept bookings only from people with a confirmed identity.

parts.name: Viewing safety settings
parts.what: Uses the kit's trusted contact link and emergency button for viewings and adds a check-in timer for the end of each viewing.

parts.name: Hosting safely
parts.what: Short guidance on securing valuables, medicines and keys, viewing in pairs, and keeping visitors safe, such as shutting dogs away, closing pool gates and marking unsafe areas.

features.name: Show a home with tenants in it
features.does: Tell tenants about the sale in writing, get their agreement before anyone enters, and book viewings, photos and visits only at times they agree.

parts.name: Tenancy rules for selling
parts.what: Encodes the duty to tell tenants in writing, the tenant's permission before anyone enters to take photos, value or inspect, and the tenant's right to refuse photos of their belongings, decline open homes and auctions at the home, ask for viewings by appointment only, be present and ask for a rent reduction. It also holds the notice periods after a sale, as one tenancy rules pack shared with Spare Rent that belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Tenant's view
parts.what: Lets tenants receive notices, approve or decline each viewing, open home, photo visit and professional visit, refuse photos of their belongings, ask to be present, ask for a rent reduction, and sign the agreed schedule.

parts.name: Written notice to tenants
parts.what: Makes and sends the written notice the law requires and keeps proof it was sent.

parts.name: Entry waits for the tenant
parts.what: Holds every photographer, valuer, inspector and viewing booking at a tenanted home until the tenant agrees to the time, blocks open homes and on-site auctions the tenant has declined, and keeps photos of the tenant's belongings off the listing if they refuse them.

parts.name: Tenancy facts on the listing
parts.what: Shows whether the home is tenanted or vacant, periodic or fixed term, when a fixed term ends, and whether it is sold with the tenancy or with vacant possession, with nothing about the tenants themselves.

parts.name: Vacant possession dates
parts.what: Links the tenancy notice to the settlement date: at least 42 days' written notice to end a periodic tenancy once a sale needs vacant possession, 90 days' notice to market the home empty, and fixed terms passing to the buyer. It warns when a settlement date comes before the tenancy can lawfully end.

features.name: Plan a day of open homes
features.does: As a buyer, see the open homes you have saved on a map and plan a route between them.

parts.name: Open home route planner
parts.what: Lists saved homes' open home times on a map and orders them into a route that fits.

features.name: View by live video
features.does: Walk a distant buyer through the home on a live video call.

parts.name: Live video viewings
parts.what: Books and runs a live video walk-through on the kit's call service, with no recording unless both agree.

features.name: Hear what buyers thought
features.does: Ask buyers for feedback after a viewing and see it in one place.

parts.name: Viewing feedback
parts.what: Sends a short optional question set after a viewing and groups the answers for the seller.

features.name: Have a host show the home
features.does: Book someone to host your viewings or open homes, if the agency line allows it.

parts.name: Viewing hosts
parts.what: Adds viewing and open home hosts as entries on the one booking flow, offered only if HM01 finds that showing a home for a seller is not agency work, or else only through licensed agents.

features.name: Warn visitors about hazards
features.does: Tell visitors and professionals about hazards before they come, such as a dog, a pool, building work, unsafe areas or known meth contamination.

parts.name: Home hazard notes
parts.what: Adds hazard notes to viewings and professional bookings on the kit's hazard notes, shown before a visit is confirmed.

areas.name: Enquiries and the buyer register
areas.summary: An agent's buyer list and phone are a big part of what a commission buys. Spare Home gives the seller a private inbox, a simple register of interested buyers and fair ways to keep them all informed, without sharing phone numbers.

features.name: Message the seller
features.does: Ask the seller a question through the app without either side sharing a phone number or email.

parts.name: Private contact for listings
parts.what: Uses the kit's chat and masked calls so neither side sees the other's number or email until they choose.

parts.name: Enquiry inbox
parts.what: One inbox for every question about a listing, with quick replies and files.

features.name: Answer common questions once
features.does: Publish answers to common questions, and get draft replies made only from facts you have approved.

parts.name: Listing questions and answers
parts.what: Lets the seller publish answers to common questions on the listing so they are asked once.

parts.name: Draft replies
parts.what: Drafts a reply from the listing's approved facts and documents for the seller to edit and send, treats buyers' messages as data and never as instructions, and never discusses price for the seller.

features.name: Keep a buyer register
features.does: See every interested buyer, what they viewed, what documents they asked for and whether they have offered.

parts.name: Buyer register
parts.what: Builds a private list of interested buyers from enquiries, viewings, document requests and offers.

parts.name: Buyer register screen
parts.what: Shows the register with status, notes and next steps for each buyer.

parts.name: Register privacy limits
parts.what: Keeps buyers' details only for this sale and deletes them after, as privacy law requires.

parts.name: Lawful criteria only
parts.what: Shows and filters buyers only by lawful criteria such as finance, conditions, dates and overseas-buyer status, never by attributes protected by human rights law.

features.name: Tell every interested buyer at once
features.does: Send the same update to every interested buyer at the same moment, such as a price change, an offer or a deadline.

parts.name: Fair updates to all buyers
parts.what: Sends one message to every registered buyer at the same time and keeps a record of who was told what and when, with personal details kept erasable by the kit's method.

features.name: Show you are ready to buy
features.does: As a buyer, share proof of finance and your lawyer's details with a seller if you choose.

parts.name: Buyer readiness card
parts.what: Holds a buyer's lawyer, finance approval and timing, shared only with sellers they pick.

features.name: Block and report
features.does: Block anyone who is rude or unsafe, and report them.

parts.name: Block and report on listings
parts.what: Uses the kit's chat reporting and blocking and attaches the listing to the report.

areas.name: Documents and disclosure
areas.summary: Buyers and their lawyers need the title, council records, reports and the seller's honest disclosures. Spare Home helps the seller gather them, says what the law requires them to disclose, and shares documents with buyers safely.

features.name: Keep every document in one place
features.does: Store the title, council records, consents, reports, plans and warranties for the home in one private vault.

parts.name: Shared document vault
parts.what: Stores documents with the property record, sorted by type, with versions and dates, as one vault shared with Spare Rent (replacing RENT-A2-F6-P1) that belongs in the kit.

parts.name: Document types
parts.what: Lists each document type, what it shows, who issues it and how old it may be, per country, including the Natural Hazards Commission claims history.

features.name: Order the title and official records
features.does: Order the record of title, the council's property report and the natural hazard claims history from inside the app at the issuer's price.

parts.name: Title ordering
parts.what: Orders the official record of title from LINZ and files it in the vault.

parts.name: How each council supplies reports
parts.what: Lists how each council takes orders for land information reports, the price and the time taken.

parts.name: Council report ordering
parts.what: Orders the council's land information report where the council allows it, or guides the seller through the council's own form.

parts.name: Natural hazard claims history
parts.what: Helps the seller request the home's claims history from the Natural Hazards Commission, formerly EQC, before listing and files it in the vault.

features.name: Know what you must disclose
features.does: Answer a guided checklist of what the law requires a seller to disclose and record your answers.

parts.name: Disclosure rules
parts.what: Encodes what sellers must disclose, such as known weathertightness problems, unconsented work and unrepaired natural hazard damage, per country and property type, in the rules-pack format.

parts.name: Disclosure checklist
parts.what: Asks the seller each question in plain words and turns the answers into a disclosure statement for buyers.

parts.name: Lawyer check of the questions
parts.what: A lawyer's review of the questions and wording, repeated when the law changes.

features.name: Sell a unit with a body corporate
features.does: Collect the body corporate's disclosure statements and give them to buyers on time.

parts.name: Unit title disclosure pack
parts.what: Gathers the pre-contract statement, minutes, accounts and levies from the body corporate and gives them to every buyer before they sign.

parts.name: Unit title deadlines
parts.what: Tracks when the pre-settlement and any extra statements are due and warns the seller early.

parts.name: Body corporate manager's side
parts.what: Sends the request for disclosure statements to the body corporate manager, takes their fee at the price they publish, lets them upload straight into the vault, and tracks the pre-settlement statement so it arrives on time.

features.name: Share documents with buyers
features.does: Give each buyer access to the documents you choose and see who opened what.

parts.name: Document sharing
parts.what: Gives chosen buyers, or anyone who asks, access to chosen documents and records each opening.

parts.name: Buyer watermarks
parts.what: Stamps each shared copy with the buyer's name and date to discourage passing it on, keeping the copy accessible.

features.name: Share reports buyers can rely on
features.does: Commission a building or other report once and let buyers rely on it, if the report writer agrees.

parts.name: Relying on seller reports
parts.what: Finds whether and how report writers let buyers rely on a report the seller paid for, and what that costs.

parts.name: Pre-sale reports in the catalogue
parts.what: Adds building inspections, meth tests and other reports as entries on the one booking flow, delivered straight into the vault.

features.name: List what stays with the house
features.does: List the chattels and fittings that stay, with photos.

parts.name: Chattels list
parts.what: Builds the list of what stays, with photos, for the listing and for the lawyers' agreement.

areas.name: Offers and methods of sale
areas.summary: The seller sees every offer in one place and runs a fair process. Offers come as documents from buyers' lawyers; the binding agreement is drawn up and signed through lawyers, never by the app, and the app never negotiates for anyone. Every tool here does more than publish an advert, so each waits on the agency-line research (HM01).

features.name: Register interest
features.does: Tell the seller you intend to make an offer, so you hear about any other offers or deadlines.

parts.name: Registered interest
parts.what: Records a buyer's intent to offer and adds them to every fair update.

features.name: Record every offer
features.does: As a seller, see every offer in one place with its price, conditions, dates and expiry; as a buyer, see where your offer stands.

parts.name: Offer register design
parts.what: Decides how offers are recorded and shown fairly, leaving the contract to lawyers.

parts.name: Offer register
parts.what: Records who offered what, when, on what conditions and until when, against the buying person or entity, as unchangeable operations, with personal details kept erasable by the kit's method.

parts.name: Offers from lawyers
parts.what: Takes a signed offer document from the buyer or their lawyer and drafts a summary of its key terms, labelled unconfirmed until a lawyer confirms it. The document's text is treated as data by the kit's hidden instruction guards and never as instructions to any AI step.

parts.name: Seller's offers screen
parts.what: Shows all offers together with expiry clocks, and tells the seller when one is about to lapse.

parts.name: Buyer's offer status
parts.what: Shows a buyer whether their offer was received, seen, countered, accepted or declined.

parts.name: Standard agreement form licence
parts.what: Finds the copyright and licence terms of the standard NZ sale and purchase agreement form, so Spare Home never copies its text or layout into guides, templates or offer screens.

features.name: Run a fair multi-offer
features.does: When more than one buyer offers, tell every buyer, set one deadline and treat everyone the same.

parts.name: Multi-offer process
parts.what: A published process: every buyer told at once, one deadline, a chance for best offers, and acknowledgements recorded.

parts.name: Running a multi-offer
parts.what: Sends the notices, collects acknowledgements and opens offers together at the deadline.

features.name: Compare offers
features.does: See offers side by side by price, conditions, deposit, finance and dates.

parts.name: Offer comparison
parts.what: Lays offers out side by side without ranking or recommending any of them.

features.name: Sell by deadline or tender
features.does: Set a date when all offers are opened together, with the option to accept one early.

parts.name: Deadline and tender mode
parts.what: Keeps offers sealed until the set time, then opens them together for the seller, showing every deadline in NZ time from the kit's NZ country pack, including the Chatham Islands, and in the buyer's own time zone.

parts.name: Tender and deadline rules
parts.what: Checks the legal and practical rules for deadline sales and tenders in each country.

features.name: Sell by auction
features.does: Hold an auction run by a licensed auctioneer, in person or online, with registered bidders.

parts.name: Auction law
parts.what: Sets out who may run a home auction, rules on seller bids and reserves, and online auction duties.

parts.name: Bidder registration
parts.what: Registers and checks bidders before the auction, with their lawyer named.

parts.name: Home auction room on the shared auction engine
parts.what: Runs a home auction with the booked licensed auctioneer, in the room or online, on one live auction engine shared with Spare Market's auctions (MKT-A6): the server clock, live bids, public bid history and fake bid checks. The engine belongs in the kit; Home adds the auctioneer's controls and registered bidders only.

parts.name: Fake and undisclosed seller bids
parts.what: Flags bids from accounts linked to the seller or to each other, on top of the shared engine's fake bid checks, and allows a bid for the seller only when the auctioneer makes it openly as the auction rules allow, so undisclosed seller bids are caught.

features.name: Record counter-offers
features.does: Record each counter-offer your lawyer sends or receives, with its expiry.

parts.name: Counter-offer record
parts.what: Records each counter-offer document and its expiry against the original offer.

features.name: Accept an offer
features.does: Record that you have signed an agreement through your lawyer, tell other buyers, and move to the conditions stage.

parts.name: Recording a sale agreement
parts.what: Records the signed agreement from the lawyers, marks the listing under offer and tells other buyers fairly.

parts.name: Electronic signing of land contracts
parts.what: Answers one question for the kit's electronic signature rules research (KIT-A25-F1-P1): when electronic signatures are valid for land sale agreements in NZ and other countries, so the app records the lawyers' signed agreements correctly.

parts.name: Back-up offers
parts.what: Keeps other buyers' interest on record in case the first agreement falls through.

features.name: Buy together or through an entity
features.does: Make an offer as joint buyers, a trust, a company or a nominee, with each person's identity and authority checked.

parts.name: Buying entities
parts.what: Records offers against the buying entity, such as joint buyers, a trust or a company, with each person's identity check and evidence of their authority to sign for it, on the shared model of who may act for whom (HOME-A1-F4-P1) rather than the kit's organisation model, which is marked next.

areas.name: From agreement to settlement
areas.summary: After the agreement is signed, both sides track conditions and dates, the lawyers handle the deposit and the money, and the move happens on settlement day. Spare Home keeps everyone on the same page and never touches the house money.

features.name: Track conditions and dates
features.does: See every condition and due date in the agreement, with reminders before each one.

parts.name: Legal date engine
parts.what: Works out due dates in working days as the signed agreement defines them, on the kit's working days and notice periods, skipping the Christmas period the agreement leaves out and the anniversary day of the region it names, and sends reminders.

parts.name: Agreement day rules
parts.what: Adds only what the standard sale agreement defines on top of the kit's NZ public holidays, regional anniversary days and working days, such as the Christmas period it leaves out of working days, kept in the NZ rules pack.

parts.name: Conditions tracker
parts.what: Shows each condition, who must act, the due date and whether it is met, for both sides and their lawyers.

parts.name: Lawyer confirms each date
parts.what: Shows each computed due date as unconfirmed until a party's lawyer confirms it, and says so on every reminder.

parts.name: Late settlement dates
parts.what: Tracks a late settlement: the settlement notice a party's lawyer sends, the days it gives, and the date penalty interest runs from as the agreement sets it, each shown as unconfirmed until a lawyer confirms it.

features.name: Keep the house money safe
features.does: See where the deposit and the price are held, by whom, and get warned about payment scams.

parts.name: House money stays with lawyers
parts.what: Product rules that stop deposits or the price ever being paid through Spare Home and point to the lawyers' trust accounts.

parts.name: Trust account rules
parts.what: Confirms how lawyers' and agents' trust accounts must hold deposits, and when they are released.

parts.name: Payment detail warnings
parts.what: Shows the lawyers' trust account details only after they pass the independent check (HOME-A11-F2-P4), and warns loudly if anyone sends new details, leaving message warnings to HOME-A15-F2-P1.

parts.name: Trust account details checked another way
parts.what: Confirms a lawyer's trust account details through a channel that does not come from the account itself, such as a call-back to the firm's number as published on the Law Society register, and shows them as unchecked until then.

features.name: Give the lawyers a shared workspace
features.does: Invite both lawyers to see the file, upload the agreement and confirm conditions.

parts.name: Lawyer register check
parts.what: Uses the kit's public register checks and re-checks to confirm a lawyer or conveyancer holds a current practising certificate, and HOME-A12-F2-P3 to prove the account holder is that person.

parts.name: Lawyers' workspace
parts.what: Gives each side's lawyer the agreement, documents, dates and messages for this sale only.

features.name: Do the pre-settlement inspection
features.does: Book the buyer's final inspection and check off chattels and agreed repairs.

parts.name: Final inspection checklist
parts.what: Books the inspection and lets the buyer tick off chattels and repairs with photos.

features.name: Settle and move
features.does: Follow a settlement day checklist for keys, meter readings, utilities and moving out.

parts.name: Settlement day checklist
parts.what: Lists every step on the day for both sides, with key hand-over confirmed by both.

parts.name: Change of address checklist
parts.what: Reminds both sides to move power, internet and other accounts and to update the electoral roll, which the law requires after a move, IRD and their driver licence address, with no paid referrals.

parts.name: Insurance until possession
parts.what: Reminds the seller to keep the home insured until the buyer takes possession, since the standard agreement leaves the risk with the seller until then, and the buyer to have cover from that day, in wording checked by a lawyer.

features.name: Hand over a tenanted home
features.does: Pass the tenancy, bond and tenancy records to the new owner, and the new owner's details to the tenant, as the law requires.

parts.name: Tenancy hand-over
parts.what: Guides the bond transfer through Tenancy Services, tells the tenant who the new owner is and when they take over, and helps the new owner give the tenant their name, contact details and address for service, as one flow shared with Spare Rent (RENT-A2-F8-P1) on the shared property record.

parts.name: Tenancy records to the buyer
parts.what: Passes the tenancy agreement, which the law requires, and with the seller's agreement the Healthy Homes records, insulation statement and condition report, to the buyer through the shared document vault, sharing only what the new landlord needs about the tenants.

features.name: Recover when a sale falls through
features.does: When a condition is not met and the agreement ends, relist quickly and tell back-up buyers.

parts.name: Sale fell through
parts.what: Records the end of the agreement from the lawyers, puts the listing back live and tells back-up buyers fairly.

features.name: Close the sale
features.does: Mark the home sold, rate the professionals and archive the sale.

parts.name: Closing a sale
parts.what: Marks the listing sold, starts the rating requests and archives the file.

features.name: Keep a record for tax
features.does: Download a sale record with dates, price and costs for your accountant, without tax advice from the app.

parts.name: Sale record pack
parts.what: Collects the dates, price and costs of the sale into one file the seller can give their accountant.

parts.name: Tax notes for the sale record
parts.what: Adds plain notes from the one tax research piece (HOME-A2-F3-P4) on what to ask an accountant, such as the bright-line test, to the sale record, without tax advice.

features.name: Get help moving
features.does: Book movers, cleaners and storage at published prices.

parts.name: Movers in the catalogue
parts.what: Adds movers, cleaners and storage as entries on the one booking flow and suggests them near settlement.

features.name: Know where to take a dispute about the sale
features.does: Find the right place for a dispute about the sale itself, which Spare Home does not decide.

parts.name: Routes for sale disputes
parts.what: Points disputes about the sale to the parties' lawyers, the Disputes Tribunal and the courts, the Real Estate Authority for licensed agents, the Law Society for lawyers and the valuers' registration board, and says the member panel decides only service disputes. Shown in the kit's help centre, and added to the kit's outside routes (KIT-A11-F7-P1) when that is built.

features.name: See linked sales
features.does: See both sets of dates when a buyer must sell first or the seller is also buying, and both sales are on Spare Home.

parts.name: Linked sale dates
parts.what: Links two sales on Spare Home and shows their key dates to the people in both who agree.

areas.name: Professional services
areas.summary: Everything an agent's commission pays for is offered separately at a published price: photographers, lawyers, valuers, inspectors, stagers, printers, body corporate managers, auctioneers and licensed agents. Every service is booked from one shared service catalogue on the kit's marketplace engine, where Spare Work's pros are listed too, so a pro keeps one account, one check and one payout, and Spare Home never calls Spare Work directly.

features.name: Book a professional at a published price
features.does: Book a photographer, lawyer, valuer, building inspector, stager, cleaner or sign installer at a price shown up front.

parts.name: Home-sale services list
parts.what: Lists each service a sale may need, what it includes and when in the sale it is usually needed, as Home's entries in the shared service catalogue (HOME-A12-F1-P5).

parts.name: Booking on the shared marketplace engine
parts.what: Books services as kit-market orders from the shared service catalogue, finding pros through the kit's search service and availability calendars, so a professional has one account and one payout across apps and Spare Home never calls Spare Work directly.

parts.name: Booking screens
parts.what: Shows nearby pros with prices, ratings and free times, and books in a few taps.

parts.name: Conduct rules for lawyers and agents
parts.what: Finds whether lawyers, conveyancers and licensed agents may take bookings and payments through a platform under their conduct rules on referral fees, fee sharing, trust accounts and client care information (unverified).

parts.name: Shared service catalogue
parts.what: One catalogue of professional and local services on the kit's marketplace engine that Spare Home, Spare Work, Spare Rent and Spare Stay all book from, with each pro's checks, prices and reviews kept once. It is the catalogue Spare Work maps as WORK-A6-F1-P3 and WORK-A19-F4-P1; no kit part maps it yet, so it belongs in the kit beside the marketplace engine (KIT-A5).

features.name: Know the pro is qualified
features.does: See that lawyers, valuers, agents and other pros hold the licence or membership their work needs.

parts.name: Home register list
parts.what: Sets which public register applies to each kind of professional, such as practising certificates for lawyers, and uses the kit's register checks and re-checks.

parts.name: What each service needs
parts.what: Lists which licence, insurance or standard each kind of service needs, per country, declared in the kit's check rules per app.

parts.name: Proof the pro is the registered person
parts.what: Confirms that whoever runs a lawyer, conveyancer, licensed agent or valuer account is the person on the register, through contact details the register or the firm publishes, such as a code to the firm's published email, an email on the firm's own domain or a call-back to its published number, never through details the account gave. It belongs in the kit beside the register checks (KIT-A2-F2).

features.name: Choose a package
features.does: Pick a bundle of services for a typical sale, priced as the sum of its parts.

parts.name: Service packages
parts.what: Bundles common services into packages with no markup and lets the seller swap any part.

features.name: Use a licensed agent at a fixed fee
features.does: Hire a licensed agent for a fixed, published fee for just the parts you want, such as negotiation.

parts.name: Fixed-fee licensed agents
parts.what: Lets licensed agents offer set tasks at fixed published fees, never a percentage.

parts.name: Hand over to a licensed agent
parts.what: Gives a booked licensed agent access to the offers and buyer register for the negotiation only.

parts.name: What the agent does
parts.what: Records the tasks the seller has hired the agent for and the agency agreement the agent provides.

features.name: Rate the professionals
features.does: Rate each professional after the job, and read others' ratings before booking.

parts.name: Ratings for pros
parts.what: Uses the kit's ratings for services booked through Spare Home, under Home's rules on what can be rated.

features.name: Book services as a buyer
features.does: As a buyer, book a building inspector, lawyer or valuer for a home you want.

parts.name: Buyer bookings
parts.what: Lets buyers use the one booking flow for a listed home, with access to the home arranged with the seller and, in a tenanted home, held until the tenant agrees.

features.name: Arrange finance and insurance
features.does: As a buyer, find a mortgage adviser or insurance broker who is registered and licensed, and see any commission they are paid.

parts.name: Advisers and brokers
parts.what: Adds mortgage advisers and insurance brokers to the catalogue, checked on the Financial Service Providers Register and for the licence financial advice law requires.

parts.name: Adviser commission policy
parts.what: Sets the policy on commissions advisers receive from lenders and insurers: shown in full to the buyer and never shared with Spare Home, in keeping with the at-cost promise.

features.name: Deliver the work into the sale
features.does: As a professional, deliver photos, reports, valuations or statements straight into the seller's vault or listing, which confirms the job.

parts.name: Delivery into the vault
parts.what: Lets a booked professional upload the result straight to the seller's vault or listing with its licence and reliance terms, and counts delivery as the job done so payment can be released.

features.name: Let pros in while you are away
features.does: Arrange key or key-safe access for a booked professional or viewing host when you cannot be there.

parts.name: Key access for bookings
parts.what: Shares a key-safe code or key pick-up details only with the booked person for the booked time, logs each use, and reminds the seller to change the code afterwards.

areas.name: Guides and checklists
areas.summary: Selling privately feels risky because people do not know the steps. Spare Home walks sellers and buyers through every legal and practical step, tied to where their own sale is up to.

features.name: Follow a step-by-step selling guide
features.does: Follow a guide from deciding to sell to settlement day, showing what is done and what comes next.

parts.name: Every step of selling privately
parts.what: Sets out every legal and practical step of a private sale, with sources.

parts.name: Selling guide
parts.what: Short plain pages for each step, kept up to date as rules change.

parts.name: Guide tied to your sale
parts.what: Shows the guide beside the seller's own sale and ticks off steps as they happen.

parts.name: Tax steps for sellers and buyers
parts.what: Explains residential land withholding tax for offshore sellers, whose IR1101 form goes to the conveyancer, and the land transfer tax statement every buyer and seller gives their lawyer, with sources.

features.name: Check you are ready to list
features.does: Tick through a readiness checklist before going live: documents, photos, disclosures, lawyer and co-owners.

parts.name: Ready-to-list checklist
parts.what: Builds a checklist from the property type and country, and links each item to where it is done.

features.name: Follow a buyer's guide
features.does: As a buyer, follow a guide to finance, lawyers, inspections, offers and settlement.

parts.name: Buying guide
parts.what: Short plain pages for each buying step, including what to ask and what to check.

parts.name: Insurance before going unconditional
parts.what: Reminds buyers to confirm they can insure the home before going unconditional, with a stronger warning in hazard areas.

parts.name: First-home steps
parts.what: Explains KiwiSaver first-home withdrawals, first-home schemes, and that banks use valuers from their own panel.

features.name: Understand the jargon
features.does: Tap any property term to see what it means in plain words.

parts.name: Plain words glossary
parts.what: Explains terms such as title, chattels, unconditional and settlement, linked wherever they appear.

features.name: Get guides for your country
features.does: Get the guide that matches your country and region's rules.

parts.name: Guides per country
parts.what: Packages the guides with each country's rules pack so a new country brings its own steps.

features.name: Ask someone who has done it
features.does: Ask questions of members who have sold or bought privately, and get support from the co-op.

parts.name: Home topics in the member forum
parts.what: Adds a moderated home-sale space to the kit's member forum, where past sellers and buyers help new ones.

parts.name: Help that is not advice
parts.what: Rules and wording so member help stays general and never becomes legal, financial or agency advice.

areas.name: Payments, fees and the open cost ledger
areas.summary: Sellers pay a small at-cost fee and the published price of any services they book. Payments go through the kit's regulated payment provider. The house price and deposit never pass through Spare Home.

features.name: Pay the at-cost listing fee
features.does: Pay a listing fee worked out from what Spare Home costs to run, shown before you list.

parts.name: Home listing fee rule
parts.what: Sets Home's fee unit, one live listing, in the kit's fee calculator: last period's running cost divided by listings.

parts.name: Paying the listing fee
parts.what: Takes the fee through the kit's payments service when the listing goes live, unless the seller has chosen to pay at settlement (HOME-A14-F3).

parts.name: Fee rules for relisting, pausing and expiry
parts.what: Sets the published rules members vote on for how the fee applies when a sale falls through and the home is relisted, when a listing is paused, expires or is withdrawn, and when the fee is to be paid at settlement, so the going-live gate knows when the fee counts as settled.

features.name: Pay for services
features.does: Pay for booked services, with the money held until the job is done, and know who you are buying from.

parts.name: Service payments
parts.what: Takes payment for services through the kit's held-payment loop and pays the professional when the job is confirmed.

parts.name: Seller of record for booked services
parts.what: Sets, on the kit's seller of record per app, who sells each service booked through Home, the professional or the co-op, which decides who charges GST, whose name is on the receipt and who answers a card dispute.

parts.name: Services in the yearly IRD report
parts.what: Includes services booked through Home, such as photography, inspections and conveyancing, in the kit's yearly report of sellers' income to IRD under the digital platform reporting rules, as the kit's reporting rules settle which services and sellers are covered.

parts.name: Which ledger carries a catalogue booking
parts.what: Records each booking from the shared service catalogue against the app it was booked from, through the kit's usage metering, so its fee and cost show once, in Spare Home's ledger, and are not counted again by Spare Work. The rule is confirmed in the kit's ledger design.

features.name: Pay when the sale settles
features.does: Choose to pay the fee and services from the sale money at settlement, through your lawyer.

parts.name: Pay at settlement
parts.what: Sends one final statement to the seller's lawyer to pay from the sale money, so nothing is paid up front.

parts.name: Paying from sale money
parts.what: Checks how lawyers can pay third parties from sale money and what happens if the sale falls through.

parts.name: Is paying at settlement credit
parts.what: Checks whether letting sellers pay Spare Home's fees at settlement counts as credit under consumer credit law, and what happens if the sale never settles.

features.name: Get proper invoices and receipts
features.does: Get a GST invoice or receipt for every payment.

parts.name: Home invoice details
parts.what: Adds Home's listing and service details to the kit's tax invoices and receipts, kept in the account.

features.name: Get a refund or raise a dispute
features.does: Ask for a refund when a listing or service is cancelled, or raise a dispute about a service.

parts.name: Home refund rules
parts.what: Sets Home's published refund rules for cancelled listings and services, carried out by the kit's refunds.

parts.name: Service disputes
parts.what: Sends disputes about a booked service to the kit's disputes service, with the payment held until a member panel decides.

features.name: See where the fee goes
features.does: See what Spare Home cost to run each month and what the fee paid for.

parts.name: Cost ledger page
parts.what: Shows Spare Home's monthly costs and fee from the open cost ledger.

areas.name: Trust, safety and moderation
